Definition
[Orbifold boundary and suborbifold] 1. 13.2.6,13.2.7\group foundations Source: thurston:page-0325, thurston:page-0326

An orbifold with boundary is locally modeled on a half-space modulo a finite group preserving the boundary hyperplane. A suborbifold is a subspace whose local inverse image in every chart is a submanifold invariant under the local group, with the induced quotient charts.
Proof

\sketch Restrict each local quotient chart to the half-space or invariant submanifold. Compatibility of the ambient charts supplies the induced atlas.

□
